2922904.note: No founding year found yet (Nov 9: first pass only: CrownHeights.info and lubavitch.com searched by name and director; not dug into yet). Its chabad.org listing went up 2015-04-29, so it existed by then. In July 2024 Rabbi Menachem and Daniela Lessoff moved to Richmond 'to launch Jewish Life at VCU, a new Chabad on Campus center' (Lubavitch.com, 25 Aug 2025, https://www.lubavitch.com/jewish-life-thrives-at-vcu/); the listing is older (2015), so a Chabad at VCU was listed before they came. Director: Menachem Mendel Lessoff.
